So, next time someone asks you if Jiu-Jitsu is like Karate, you can confidently say “no” and educate them on the rich history behind both martial arts.

It’s like a game of human chess, where strategy and technique trump brute strength. So, next time someone refers to Jiu-Jitsu as “ground karate,” just chuckle and invite them to join you on the mats for a friendly roll.
